_doc: GOLDEN-PATH host wiring — how a human-polished demo gets structure props that CSS cannot fake. Builder + orchestrator MUST load this (node scripts/knowledge.mjs host-wiring) during structure build. R18's exception: Connect-Map / plan-structure hostProps + the unstyled base + <VeltCustomization/> ARE the integration — APPLY and KEEP them (do not temporary-apply-and-revert).

doctrine.authority: plan-structure.json components[].hostProps (design-gated, R24) + always-on infra below. Structure a prop produces (Show N replies, placeholders, page-mode composer variant) must never be attempted in CSS.
doctrine.applyPolicy: APPLY + KEEP + VERIFY. Never list a required prop as BLOCKED/manual-only without first running verify-host-wiring.mjs --apply and re-checking. Temporary-apply-revert is ONLY for exploratory non-plan host chrome — not for plan hostProps.
when: After plan-structure lint passes, BEFORE build-structure families complete (orchestrator runs verify; builder applies if missing).
After structure build, BEFORE dom-snapshot (missing collapsedComments → wrong skeleton → poisoned style plan).
At builder-self-audit / handoff — exit 2 blocks style/judge progress.

alwaysOn.why: Pipeline snapshots, style plan, and judge assume the unstyled base.
Wireframe registry never loads without the mount (R1).

alwaysOn.where: VeltComments / VeltCommentsSidebar (and any surface receiving class CSS)
alwaysOn.why: Class CSS cannot pierce shadow DOM.

structureProps.designCue: Show N replies / MoreReply / first+last collapsed teaser
last reply previewed under Show N control
composer at sidebar level, no pin anchors in the Loop
pageMode sidebar with a designed page-level composer (ALWAYS when pageMode is set)
structureProps.produces: page-mode composer wireframe mounts (without this the composer is 0-height / empty — CSS cannot invent it)

traps.symptom: Show N replies / placeholders missing; defects attributed BLOCKED host-change.
traps.cause: Agents treat R18 as 'never edit host' and only list props in the handoff.
traps.fix: R18 forbids non-Velt host chrome changes. Plan hostProps + unstyled + VeltCustomization are required integration — bake them, verify with verify-host-wiring.mjs.

traps.symptom: Builder tries to CSS-fake a Show N replies control.
traps.fix: Set both props on the host; then style the MoreReply slot.

traps.symptom: pageModeComposerVariant is set on VeltCommentsSidebar but page-mode composer stays 320×0 / body display:none / no input in DOM.
traps.cause: The variant string (e.g. pageModeComposer) was never registered as <VeltCommentDialogWireframe variant="…"> inside <VeltWireframe>. Velt falls back to an empty default dialog shell.
traps.fix: APPLY the host prop AND register a matching VeltCommentDialogWireframe variant (PageModeComposer wireframe) in VeltCustomization. Prop alone is not enough. Verify live: composer box non-zero + contenteditable present + placeholder visible.
